messages:
jessica.sales: Heads up — LedgerWave POC is flapping during the warmup step. Customer hit a spike around 13:05 PT, now seeing a mix of 503s + 429s. They want a war-room now. Can we triage?
ryan.se: on it. Can you paste the error samples and the cURL they used?
jessica.sales: copied log snippet from the call: 
```
2026-03-20T20:05:12Z INFO request_id=abc123 model=rw-large latency_ms=18 status=200
2026-03-20T20:06:01Z WARN request_id=abc456 model=rw-large latency_ms=1200 status=503 backend=timeout_kernel
2026-03-20T20:06:02Z ERROR request_id=abc457 model=rw-large status=429 reason=rate_limit exceeded limit=300/min
```
jessica.sales: curl they ran: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --d '{"model":"rw-large","input":"summarize...","max_tokens":1024}'
```
maliha.eng: looks like two separate issues: a backend kernel timeout causing 503s and a throttle on their side hitting our rate limit. Any chance they're running a tight loop from the UI?
jessica.sales: ledgerwave-pmo on the call said they did a bulk warmup script that spun up 500 concurrent short requests to warm sessions. they thought concurrency => throughput.
priya.sre: @ryan.se can you share the project id / api key so i can pull quota logs? i want to check our ingress queue and token buckets.
ryan.se: project id: lw-prod-23, key redacted here. i'll DM the key.
priya.sre: digging into metrics now — seeing a burst that aligns with the timestamps. ingress queue length spiked to 3.2k and we triggered the protective rate limiter for that org for ~90s. that explains the 429s. also seeing a small uptick in kernel timeouts concurrent with the burst.
maliha.eng: kernel timeouts likely due to KV memory pressure from many parallel sessions and long context windows. which model config did they pick?
jessica.sales: they pinned rw-large-8k and were setting max_tokens=1024 and streaming enabled.
maliha.eng: rw-large-8k + 500 concurrent with streaming + big prompt = memory pressure. we need to either advise different warmup pattern or route them to Dedicated pool.
palmira.salesops: customer asked about Dedicated pricing during the call — can we get a quick ballpark for a short-term reserved? they want dedicated for 48 hours to run load tests.nyan.se: ballpark: small Dedicated pool starts at $Xk/mo but we can offer a time-limited dev-reserve for POC; will route to finance for approval.
priya.sre: mitigation steps now: 1) throttle client warmup script to <= 50 concurrent connections, 2) use a prefix warmup single request pattern to prime KV cache instead of 500 parallel, 3) enable lightweight short-lived context (set max_tokens=256) during warmup, 4) we can temporarily bump org burst quota for 15 mins if sales approves.
jessica.sales: passing recommendations in the call. ledgerwave asks if we can temporarily bump quota immediately so they can finish the warmup window before EOD.
maliha.eng: we can escalate quota bump but need approval from infra lead. @palmira.salesops can you confirm POC terms so we can do a 1-2 hour exception?
palmira.salesops: confirmed — approved for a time-limited bump (2 hours) under CRO approval. I'll ping legal/finance for note.
priya.sre: performed a manual 2-hour quota bump for lw-prod-23 and cleared ingress backlog; watch for residual 503s during kernel GC.
ryan.se: after bump, ledgerwave tried again and initial warmup succeeded but then saw intermittent 503s after ~7 minutes. logs show kernel OOM on worker-7.
maliha.eng: worker-7 OOM indicates we hit a memory leak/peak due to streaming + long KV accumulation. immediate workaround: switch them to non-streaming calls for warmup (single response) and reduce context window. i'll open a ticket to investigate persistent memory growth.
priya.sre: put a temporary route fallback to rw-medium-4k for that org for next 30 mins to smooth capacity while eng investigates. applied routing rule.
jessica.sales: ledgerwave PM says fallback is fine for now. they want a post-mortem and a recommended warmup guide.
ryan.se: i'll own the doc with step-by-step warmup pattern and pricing note for Dedicated trial. @maliha.eng can you add kernel recommendations and a TODO to investigate memory accounting?
maliha.eng: will do. creating ENG ticket now: ENG-PLAT-5472 — investigating KV memory accounting + streaming interplay.
deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-20T20:30:00Z: routing rule applied to org lw-prod-23 (fallback -> rw-medium-4k) by priya.sre.
priya.sre: closing the war-room for now. follow-ups: - ENG-PLAT-5472 (maliha) - Docs warmup guide (ryan) - Sales pricing note for short-term Dedicated (palmira)
jessica.sales: thanks all. i'll send a recap to LedgerWave and schedule a 1:1 demo to walk recommended warmup. :thumbsup:
